mappings.rationale: Explicitly labelled supplier ABN column. Semicolon-separated lists are split into individual ABNs, each validated by the abn transform (normalises spaces, enforces checksum, rejects invalid values). Held-out validation shows 55 valid emissions and 2 checksum failures on the raw value '631 566 697', which is a 9-digit (truncated) value and is correctly rejected. Emitted as identifier-only supplier claims with separate_entities:true; no names or addresses attached.

Buyer/agency address; must not be mapped to supplier address.
Contract award date; not a registration date or observation time.
Contract commencement date; not a supplier registration date.
Procurement category, not an ANZSIC industry code; not mapped.
Contract description, not a supplier trading name.
Contract administration field; empty in held-out data; out of scope.
Contract administration field; out of scope. Contains SOA/contract-like codes, not supplier identifiers.
Contract reference, not a supplier identifier.
Contract value; must not be mapped to business identity or address.
Contract scope text; out of scope.
Procurement evaluation text; out of scope.
Contract finish date; not a registration date.
Contract form; not an entity attribute.
Procurement justification; out of scope.
Procurement metric; out of scope.
Contract/SOA reference; not a supplier identifier.
Procurement method; out of scope.
Procurement disclosure flag; out of scope.

Multi-supplier semicolon-separated addresses cannot be safely paired with ABNs by index; held-out sample shows 9 non-empty values with inconsistent formatting and no explicit per-supplier pairing. Left unmapped.

Business trading/supplier name is not established as a registered legal name (procurement register, not a registry); multi-supplier cells cannot be paired safely. Left unmapped for conservative ingest.
Procurement flag; out of scope.
Internal row identifier of the source file, not an entity identifier.

warnings: observed_at_field set to null: the only available timestamp (observed_at / resource_last_modified_proxy) is a publication proxy, not a verified source statement time.
Supplier ABN checksum validation only; ABNs not verified against the ABR.

No ACN mapping: held-out and training profiles show 2 ACN-checksum-valid values in held-out data (and 0 in training), but ACN is never inferred from ABN and the column is labelled as ABN; no ACN mapping proposed.
Held-out checksum_valid_acn count of 2 likely reflects 9-digit values in the Supplier ABN column that are invalid ABNs; they are not treated as ACNs.

Supplier name is the strongest candidate for entity.legal_name but is left unmapped; it is a trading/supplier name rather than verified registered legal name, and multi-supplier cells cannot be paired safely.
semantic_risks: Supplier ABN cells may contain multi-supplier lists; the split-then-validate path with separate_entities:true emits identifier-only claims that are not linked to names or addresses.
Held-out values '631 566 697' (9 digits) are truncated/invalid ABNs and are rejected; source may contain data-entry errors.
ABN validity is checksum-only; ABN-to-entity linkage is unverified and the source is a procurement register, not an ABR extract.
Supplier names are not mapped; downstream consumers cannot attach a legal name to identifiers from this source.
Supplier address is not mapped; addresses are not attributable to a single party in multi-supplier rows.
Observation timestamp is a publication proxy; observed_at_field is null so observed_at will not be derived from the proxy.
Some ABN-labelled rows in the held-out sample show the same ABN across many contract rows; deduplication is required downstream to avoid overcounting.
